test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 8 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following options correctly describes the features of arteries?

options.text: Thick walls, blood flows under low pressure, collect blood from different parts of the body
Thick walls, no valves, blood flows under high pressure, carry blood to different parts of the body
Thin walls with valves, blood flows under low pressure, collect blood from different parts of the body
Thin walls with valves, blood flows under high pressure, carry blood to different parts of the body

solution:
The correct answer is __**Thick walls, no valves, blood flows under high pressure, carry blood to different parts of the body.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__**

__
 
• **Blood **flows through the **arteries**.
 
• Most transport **oxygen-rich blood away** from the **heart **while delivering it **to **various **organs and tissues.**
 
• **Arteries **are a part of **circulatory system,** along with **heart **and the other blood vessels.
 
• The blood in arteries is typically **oxygenated**.
 
• As opposed to the **pulmonary artery**, which transports **deoxygenated blood **to the **lungs **for **oxygenation**, the pulmonary vein transports oxygenated blood back to the heart, where it is subsequently dispersed to rest of body through other arteries.
 
• Unlike arteries, which direct blood away from the heart, **veins **direct blood toward the heart.
 
• Because the arteries experience** higher pressures** than other blood vessels, they are often **thicker **and more **elastic**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information:__**

 
• Normally, an artery has **three layers:**
 
• **Tunica intima:**
 
 
• The **innermost layer **of this layer is made up of elastic membranes and tissues that support healthy blood flow.
 
 
 
• ​**Tunica media:**
 
 
• This layer is the **middle **and thickest.
 
• There is **elastin **and **smooth **muscle.
 
 
 
• **Tunica adventitia: **
 
 
• Elastin and collagen fibres make up the tunica adventitia, which adds **strength**.
 
• This layer also enables the **dilation **and **widening **of **arteries**, which is essential for controlling blood pressure.
